# Link Extractor

> A free Chrome extension that lists every link on the page you have open: full URLs with their link text, in page order, without duplicates. Filter the list, copy it, or export a CSV for Excel. It runs in the browser, needs no account and sends no links anywhere.

It is not a crawler: it works with the one open tab, does not follow links and does not check status codes. Copying and the CSV file include every link in the list, nothing is cut off; the extension reads up to 200,000 links from the page and as many from each embedded frame.

## Pages

- [Home page and FAQ](https://link-extractor.com/): what it does, how to export links to CSV, mailto/tel links, single-page apps, large pages
- [How to export all links from a page to a CSV that opens in Excel](https://link-extractor.com/guides/export-links-to-csv/): step by step; UTF-8 with a byte order mark, comma or semicolon separator, the columns of the file, when another tool is better
- [How to remove UTM tags and unwrap redirect links](https://link-extractor.com/guides/remove-tracking-and-redirects/): which tracking tags are removed and which stay, which redirect wrappers are unwrapped, what is not (short links, URLs Google hides)
- [How to extract all links from a large page with 10,000+ links](https://link-extractor.com/guides/extract-links-from-large-pages/): what happens on huge pages, the 200,000-link limit, infinite scroll, when another tool is better
- [How to extract email, phone and PDF links from a page](https://link-extractor.com/guides/extract-email-phone-and-file-links/): which links count as email, phone and files, how to keep only them, what is not found (plain-text addresses)
- [How to copy link text and URL pairs into Excel, in page order](https://link-extractor.com/guides/copy-link-text-and-url/): Table for Excel, Text — URL and CSV; how link text, order and repeats are chosen
- [Privacy policy](https://link-extractor.com/privacy/)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/jhkaajdkjhnfgllboflfppkhaaclfagg)
